_about: Where each generated logo in public/logos came from and how it was made. To rebuild one, download its source and run: node scripts/logos/make-logo.mjs <source> public/logos/<out> <args>

logos.note: One-line wordmark stacked into two lines, as in Springer Nature's own stacked version
Top half only: drops the 'Advancing Technology for Humanity' tagline
Erases the rule and tagline beside the key; a little wider than the default so the thin serif lettering reads at 50 px
App Store icon: the dark robot only, sized down because a solid mark reads heavier than outlines and wordmarks
